reviews.review_title: It’s a good idea but needs a little work
reviews.review_description:
I love the idea, it’s somewhat original and decently executed. Taking the liminality of the Backrooms and creating a story. This being said, it needs a little work.

There are a few issues I have
• Jumpscares kick you from the game
• Falling into the void doesn’t respawn you
• At times I’ll be randomly jumpscared
• Voice chat is too quiet and sound effects are too loud

But without running into these issues it’s a really fun game.
I played with my friends and we completed the dreamcore levels together and I enjoyed playing.  

In conclusion, fun gameplay, needs some polishing, and I hope I can play more games by this creator.

Edit and note for owner: I wish you the best of luck while making this game and hope you run into very few bugs.

Hi, a moderator here. The game has awesome graphics and scary levels. Weird core, dream core, and that untitled map are made to be scary. The game may be early access  but it's scary, fun, and gives horror backrooms nostalgia type. Thank u harry for creating this game.
This game is good but needs a little more improvements. The player model, dreamcors, etc. Recommend this game if your bored.

developer_response.body:
Hello, I am so sorry about the rudeness from one of out developers, but the Clock level's lag is going to be fixed today, along with all of the monsters and keys. There will also be a motion sickness and flashing lights warning in the loading screen. Also, the low quality does disable URP, and I am making the high quality better. 

Once again I am so sorry for the game being bad, yes I do agree to an extent, but the game just released a few weeks ago, don't expect a masterpiece. So just wanted to say that everything is going to be fixed later today.

-Derealization Dev team

developer_response.body:
Hi, so I just wanted to say that nothing being scary, and things being on Sketchfab doesn't seem like it would be more of a one star game. Also, Sketchfab models are there to be free. The reason I use these models is because they are allowed for use. Also reviews are for the game, and not about the developer team. Once again, I'm sorry about one of the developers being rude, and the game will have more scary content later on. Thank you for the feedback.

-Derealization developer team.
